params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: On Instellingen > Service & Diensten > Transport the vehicle class column of the price table and the class names in the dimensions matrix are empty, so nobody can tell which price belongs to which class.

Source: Portal mail:19.

**Cause.** `SettingsController::index` selects the class name as `name_<lang> as name`. `VehicleClass` and `VehicleClassItem` have a `getNameAttribute` accessor that reads `name_<lang>` and `name_nl` from the model; those columns were not selected, so the accessor returns null and hides the aliased value. Empty for every user since the accessor was added (32ecb994).
params.title: Transport settings: vehicle class names are empty in the price table and the dimensions matrix
